_comment: Simulated status page of Nakhla Systems (fictional). {TODAY} and {TODAY-N} are replaced with HELPDESK_TODAY (or N days before) when the API loads this file. Served by GET /api/status.

incidents.title: VPN gateway GW-2 degraded
incidents.affected: Employees connected through gateway GW-2 (Ramallah office and remote staff assigned to GW-2).
incidents.symptoms: NakhlaConnect shows NX-503 or disconnects every few minutes.
incidents.workaround: In NakhlaConnect open Settings > Gateway and select GW-1 (Jerusalem), then reconnect. Finance users stay on GW-3 and are not affected.
incidents.instructions: Do not open individual tickets for this problem. Add yourself to INC-2207 on the status page (Affected? > Subscribe) to get updates.

updates.text: Investigating reports of NX-503 on GW-2.
A failed load balancer node on GW-2 has been identified. Network Operations is replacing it. Use GW-1 meanwhile.

incidents.title: Delayed inbound external email
incidents.affected: All employees receiving email from outside nakhla.example.
incidents.symptoms: External messages arrived up to 4 hours late; senders saw NXM-421 delay notices.
incidents.instructions: Resolved. Delayed messages were delivered. No action needed.

updates.text: Inbound mail queue is growing. Collaboration Services is investigating.
Resolved: the mail filtering service was restarted and the queue has drained.
